description.value: Tofino Coffee Roasting Company is a locally-owned specialty roastery that ethically sources beans from farms in Guatemala, Peru, Ethiopia, and beyond, roasting them on a Loring S15 in Tofino, BC. The Industrial Way location is the production roastery, where visitors can pick up takeaway coffee and whole-bean purchases directly; the company's full café experience is at a separate address on Gibson Street in the town centre. Beans are also sold online with Canada-wide shipping.

raw_osm.description: Note that this is the Tofino Coffee Roasting Co. roastery, not the café. This location only offers take-away coffee and bean sales
raw_osm.name: Tofino Coffee Roasting Company
